title: quercus rubra f. cuneata
intro: Quercus rubra f. cuneata, commonly known as Red Oak, is a variety of the Red Oak tree that is native to North America. This deciduous tree is valued for its timber and medicinal properties, with uses including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Quercus rubra f. cuneata are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The health benefits of Quercus rubra f. cuneata are thought to include reducing the risk of heart disease, improving cognitive function, and supporting immune system function.
